title: fix: allow guests to select managed project worktrees
body: Closes #171792 ## What Problem This Solves Guests who can create sessions can select registered projects in New Session, but cannot choose a managed worktree when the project list correctly omits host paths. The repository controller treated those project rows as idle, hiding the checkout control even though creation by project ID already supports isolation. ## User Impact A guest can select a registered or Gateway-cloned project, choose **New worktree**, and start an isolated session without broad operator scopes. Leaving the base reference blank lets the Gateway choose the repository default. The existing creation owner checks the current repository and authorization and reports unavailable sources; a refusal keeps the selected project and isolation intent available for correction or retry. ## Why This Change Was Made The UI now distinguishes a path-redacted registered project awaiting creation-time validation from an inspected Git checkout. It carries the existing project ID and worktree choice to `sessions.create` without attempting host-path branch discovery. Clients with disclosed checkout paths retain their existing inspection flow. The change adds no Gateway fields, scope grants, configuration, or path disclosure. ## Evidence The before state was captured through an authenticated guest browser. A direct request with only session scopes, a registered project ID, and `worktree: true` already created an owned managed worktree with the default branch, establishing that the missing behavior belongs to UI selection. Focused UI coverage exercises project selection, worktree submission without a host path or forced reference, and preservation of isolation after an actionable creation refusal. The existing sandbox-project integration is strengthened to use actual guest Gateway request admission and verify managed ownership while retaining the direct-access rejection. The remote candidate passed changed-file formatting/lint, affected type checks, and 138 tests across nine files. The two new UI cases failed on the baseline specifically because the checkout control was hidden. The Gateway integration passed before and after the UI repair. The related test batch took 47.06 seconds. Its Gateway file took 38.51 seconds including cold worker preparation and compilation; all eight UI files completed in 4.08 seconds. [Hosted CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38519108926) completed 32 selected jobs successfully. The updater module-outcome row failed because its existing fixture does not admit newer updater dependency calls; the same nine native cases fail on CI's base revision with identical causal inputs. That failure is unrelated to this UI change and is recorded separately from the passing picker proof. CI tested merge `46684609830cc8286d064e7262f837d16799988f` onto base `b9b159b832b6202b9100dd6a5b17f88444248fb3`. On that clean base, Linux Node 24.19.0 running `node --experimental-vm-modules --test-reporter=tap --test scripts/tests/update-restart-module-outcome.mjs` produced 19 cases: 10 passed, 9 failed, 0 skipped in 2.525 seconds. The failures reproduce the same unhandled `acquireWithWait` and `collectUpdateDoctorFailureFacts` fixture calls; all 57 recorded source, fixture, and dependency identities match the CI composition. The fixture repair has since landed on main in `6772d6f6464b337141571c3ec8d77be3a04bc101` and `848c1398774de8545b0da7b14f847b676c1eda8a`; the same native command passes all 19 cases on target `a6f7f6cde4d00469811771f7b5899d93f7230595`, with its current inputs unchanged in the prospective result. The normal guest UI flow with a nonempty first message has also created a session-owned worktree using only session scopes, the selected project ID, and isolation intent. The matched comparison and focused recording below document the restored control and accepted first-message flow. Browser proof uses the explicitly identified composed runtime; source equivalence is qualified for this picker and its registered-project path. Full PR-head tests and types remain separate evidence. ## Visual evidence []() | Before | After | | --- | --- | | ![Registered project selected but Checkout choice missing](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aca1e910-b7f5-4a3b-8a2b-524c2033a85f) | ![Same registered project shows Current checkout selector](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/62d60218-bbb4-443e-9fb0-6de2ccf420c7) | ### Guest chooses New worktree, submits a nonempty message, and starts a session https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/24f00c6b-0b87-4bb1-9037-f54336842eaa ### Visual verification - Baseline: d548d4d5af14be301420ee879c1a22cd0f88d607 - Exact head: `4877f513f156a5b9b73879b8287a6ec6bc4f6097` - Scenario: Select the registered GitHub Guest Lab project as a guest, choose New worktree, enter a nonempty first message, and start an accepted running session\. - Runtime/build: Actual composed runtime 4877f513 with picker candidate 2d312cb859fd7102ef0566e9795a5d6314dd8fe4 and publisher candidate 0650abcf82c428cb206d48f46befa23f552da6a9\. This is not a full PR\-head test\. - Guest scopes: operator\.sessions\.read and operator\.sessions\.write only - Creation request: Registered projectId, worktree true and a nonempty message; no repoRoot or baseRef - Acceptance: sessions\.create succeeded, runStarted true, required sandbox; running turn visible - Source qualification: Composed4877 runtime contains the unchanged picker2d312 implementation; unrelated device\-folder support differs from the full PR base\. - Framing: Both stills and recording remove the same top 48px; source viewport 1280×900, published dimensions 1280×852 - Only existing captured pixels used; originals retained\. - Model labels and account initials masked; product selection and submitted text preserved\. - Same top48px cropped from both stills and recording; the unrelated stylesheet\-warning area is excluded while the transient preference\-save warning remains visible\. - Real request/acceptance observations retained privately; publication result omitted from the focused creation clip\. - Registered\-project repository state and submission path qualified against2d312; no device\-folder placement is selected\. Full PR\-head focused types/tests are separate evidence\.
